# Templates for the reference rendering: one template per line.
# A line starting with "#" is a comment; blank lines are skipped. Ids t001, t002, ... follow the order of
# the template lines; the comment before each line names its source: md:N is line N of
# osxphotos/phototemplate.md, py:N is line N of osxphotos/phototemplate.py, field is a template field,
# literal is a template that does not depend on the photo, quirk is a behaviour of osxphotos worth pinning down.
# Lines that use album_project come last: that field changes the album list of the photo it renders,
# so a line that reads the albums after it would see projects in them.

# == text and flag fields ==

{name}

{original_name}

# t109 operator matches

# == conditions on literals ==
# t126 literal operator contains
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s contains Beach?Y,N}
# t127 literal operator contains
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s not contains Beach?Y,N}
# t128 literal operator contains with alternatives
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s contains Sea|Day?Y,N}
# t129 literal operator contains with alternatives
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s contains Sea|Moon?Y,N}
# t130 literal operator matches
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s matches Beach Day?Y,N}
# t131 literal operator matches
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s not matches Beach Day?Y,N}
# t132 literal operator matches with alternatives
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s matches Beach|Beach Day?Y,N}
# t133 literal operator matches
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s matches Beach?Y,N}
# t134 literal operator startswith
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s startswith Be?Y,N}
# t135 literal operator startswith
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s not startswith Be?Y,N}
# t136 literal operator endswith
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s endswith Day?Y,N}
# t137 literal operator endswith
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s not endswith Day?Y,N}
# t138 literal operator ==
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s == Beach Day?Y,N}
# t139 literal operator == does not split the value on the pipe
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s == Beach|Day?Y,N}
# t140 literal operator !=
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s != Beach Day?Y,N}
# t141 literal operator !=
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s not != Beach Day?Y,N}
# t142 literal condition with several spaces around the operator
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s  contains  Beach?Y,N}
# t143 literal condition without a bool value
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s contains Beach}
# t144 literal condition without a bool value
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s contains Nope}
# t145 literal condition value is a template
{var:s,Beach Day}{%s contains {%s}?Y,N}

{var:n,5}{%n <= 5?Y,N}
# t147 literal operator <=
{var:n,5}{%n not <= 5?Y,N}
# t148 literal operator >=
{var:n,5}{%n >= 6?Y,N}
# t149 literal operator >=
{var:n,5}{%n not >= 6?Y,N}
# t150 literal operator <
{var:n,5}{%n < 5?Y,N}
# t151 literal operator <
{var:n,5}{%n not < 5?Y,N}
# t152 literal operator >
{var:n,5}{%n > 4?Y,N}
# t153 literal operator >
{var:n,5}{%n not > 4?Y,N}
# t154 literal operator ==
{var:n,5}{%n == 5?Y,N}
# t155 literal operator ==
{var:n,5}{%n not == 5?Y,N}
# t156 literal operator !=
{var:n,5}{%n != 5?Y,N}
# t157 literal operator !=
{var:n,5}{%n not != 5?Y,N}
# t158 quirk: == compares strings, not numbers
{var:n,5.0}{%n == 5?Y,N}
# t159 literal operator > with a decimal value
{var:n,5}{%n > 4.5?Y,N}

{title,}

{title&}

{title?Y,}

{title?,N}

{title,I have no title}
# t171 default is a template
{title,{original_name}}
# t172 default is a nested template
{title,{descr,{original_name}}}
# t173 bool value on a multi-valued field
{keyword?has keywords,no keywords}
# t174 combine with bool value and default
{keyword&{album}?T,F}
# t175 all parts of a field except the condition
{; +keyword|lower[a,b]&{album}?Y,N}
# t176 bool value without default
{hdr?ISHDR}
# t177 default on a field that has a value
{hdr,H}
# t178 bool value and default are templates
{edited?{created.year},{original_name}}
# t179 nested bool values and defaults
{title?{title},{descr?{descr},{original_name}}}

{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|join}
# t227 literal join with a variable as the argument
{var:d,-}{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|join(%d)}
# t228 literal append
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|append(z)}

# t235 literal slice
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|slice(1:)}
# t236 literal slice
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|slice(:-1)}
# t237 literal slice with a negative step
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|slice(::-1)}
# t238 literal slice with a single number
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|slice(2)}
# t239 literal slice with a negative start
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|slice(-2:)}
# t240 literal slice past the end
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|slice(10:)}
# t241 literal append with a variable as the argument
{var:x,Z}{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|append(%x)}
# t242 literal prepends with a variable as the argument
{var:x,Z}{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|prepends(%x)}
# t243 literal remove with a variable as the argument
{var:x,b}{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|remove(%x)}
# t244 literal filter contains
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|filter(contains a)}
# t245 literal filter not contains
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|filter(not contains a)}
# t246 literal filter startswith
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|filter(startswith b)}
# t247 literal filter endswith
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|filter(endswith c)}
# t248 literal filter matches with alternatives
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|filter(matches a|b)}
# t249 literal filter ==
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|filter(== a)}
# t250 literal filter !=
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|filter(!= a)}
# t251 literal filter not matches
{var:l,d;b;a;c;b;a}{%l|split(;)|filter(not matches a)}
# t252 literal chop
{var:w,hello;world}{%w|split(;)|chop(1)}
# t253 literal chomp
{var:w,hello;world}{%w|split(;)|chomp(1)}
# t254 literal chop(0)
{var:w,hello;world}{%w|split(;)|chop(0)}
# t255 literal chop past the length
{var:w,hello;world}{%w|split(;)|chop(10)}
# t256 literal chomp past the length
{var:w,hello;world}{%w|split(;)|chomp(10)}
# t257 literal int

# == find and replace ==
# t296 md:84
{album[/,-]}
# t297 md:84
{album[/,-|:,-]}
# t298 md:163
{title[:,%%]}
# t299 find and replace on a multi-valued field
{keyword[a,b]}
# t300 find and replace after a field argument
{folder_album(>)[>,/]}
# t301 literal find and replace
{var:p,a/b:c}{%p[/,-]}
# t302 literal two pairs
{var:p,a/b:c}{%p[/,-|:,-]}
# t303 literal empty replacement
{var:p,a/b:c}{%p[/,]}
# t304 literal escaped percent sign
{var:p,a/b:c}{%p[:,%%]}
# t305 md:155 on a literal
{var:pipe,{pipe}}{var:p,a-b}{%p[-,%pipe]}
# t306 md:155
{var:pipe,{pipe}}{title[-,%pipe]}
# t307 literal variable as the replacement
{var:p,a-b}{var:v,X}{%p[-,%v]}
# t308 literal variable as the text to find
{var:p,a-b}{var:f,-}{%p[%f,_]}
# t309 literal braces in the replacement
{var:p,a-b}{%p[-,{x}]}
# t310 literal pairs applied in order
{var:p,abc}{%p[a,b|b,c]}
# t311 literal find and replace on every value
{var:p,a-1;b-2}{%p|split(;)[-,_]}
# t312 literal comma in the text to find
{var:p,a{comma}b-c}{%p[a,b,c]}
# t313 literal empty text to find
{var:p,a-b}{%p[,x]}

# == variables, combine and products without photo data ==
# t387 md:159
{var:year,{created.year}}{original_name}-{%year}
# t388 md:159
{var:name,Katie}{person contains {%name}?{%name},Not-{%name}}
# t389 md:157 with real fields in place of template1, template2
{var:myvar,{keyword&{album,},}}{%myvar|uniq}
# t390 md:163
{title contains Foo?{title}{percent},{title}}
# t391 literal variable defined from a variable
{var:a,x}{var:b,{%a}y}{%b}
# t392 literal variable used twice
{var:a,x}{%a}-{%a}
# t393 literal bool value on a variable
{var:a,x}{%a?Y,N}
# t394 literal filter on a variable
{var:a,x}{%a|upper}
# t395 literal combine
{var:s,a}{var:t,b}{%s&{%t}}
# t396 literal combine with an empty default
{var:s,a}{var:t,b}{%s&{%t,}}
# t397 literal bool value that is a variable
{var:s,a}{var:t,b}{%s?{%t},none}
# t398 literal variable as the delimiter
{var:d,; }{%d+keyword}
# t399 literal product of two lists
{var:s,a;b}{var:t,1;2}{%s|split(;)}-{%t|split(;)}
# t400 literal product of two lists without a separator
{var:s,a;b}{var:t,1;2}{%s|split(;)}{%t|split(;)}
# t401 literal text before and after a list
x{var:s,a;b}{%s|split(;)}y

# == quirks of osxphotos ==
# t402 quirk: a variable in the middle of a replacement is not expanded
{var:p,a-b}{var:v,X}{%p[-,a%v]}
# t403 quirk: titlecase capitalizes after an apostrophe
{var:t,they're o'neil}{%t|titlecase}
# t404 quirk: upper turns a sharp s into two letters
{var:t,straße}{%t|upper}
